BO-34

BODY — Back Door Glass

4. APPLY ADHESIVE
(a) Put masking tape around the weatherstrip to protect the paint and glass.

(b) Apply adhesive between the weatherstrip and glass and between the weatherstrip and body.
Part No. 08833-00030 or equivalent
NOTE: When adhesive is dry, remove the masking tape.

5. INSTALL FOLLOWING PARTS:
(a) Window defogger wire connector
(b) Rear wiper arm

6. INSTALL REAR SPOILER
(a) Install the four clips to the spoiler.
(b) Install the spoiler to the back door.
(c) Connect the high mount stop light wire connector.
(d) Tighten the eight nuts.
(e) Install the back door trim.
